OpenAI Adds iCloud Integration to ChatGPT Via New Plugins

Expanding Connectivity

OpenAI has launched new plugins allowing ChatGPT to interface directly with Apple's iCloud Mail and iCloud Calendar. Users can now utilize the AI chatbot to manage email inboxes, search for messages, and update calendar appointments via natural language prompts.

Implementation and Scope

To activate these features, users must link their Apple account and generate an app-specific password. The functionality is available across desktop, web, and iOS platforms for both free and paid ChatGPT tiers. Notably, these plugins operate independently of local macOS apps, specifically targeting data hosted within Apple’s cloud ecosystem.

Verified Details

While these tools mirror previous Google Workspace integrations, their release occurs amidst a complex corporate dynamic between OpenAI and Apple. Readers can verify setup instructions and availability at the official source: https://www.engadget.com/2299026/chatgpt-can-work-with-your-icloud-mail-and-calendar-thanks-to-new-plugin-support/.
